mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_channel_health_snapshot (channel_id, channel_name, score, error_rate, probe_score, avg_latency_ms, sampled_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{score}, #{errorRate}, #{probeScore}, #{avgLatencyMs}, #{sampledAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.channel_id, s.channel_name, s.score, s.error_rate, s.probe_score, s.avg_latency_ms, s.sampled_at FROM mcp_channel_health_snapshot s JOIN ( SELECT channel_id, MAX(sampled_at) AS max_sampled FROM mcp_channel_health_snapshot GROUP BY channel_id ) m ON s.channel_id = m.channel_id AND s.sampled_at = m.max_sampled ORDER BY s.score ASC, s.channel_id
